metrics.text: Explore the bones, tendons, and ligaments in a lateral knee cutaway, then follow the movement forces.
The femur meets the tibia across articular cartilage and two menisci that improve fit, distribute load, and absorb shock. The patella glides in the femoral trochlea.
Match each illustration’s numbered markers to its structure key.
This lateral cutaway shows the patella to the left of the femur and tibia.
Trace the force source: use the neuromuscular model to see how skeletal muscle generates force that crosses a joint.
